mapper.select: SELECT message, severity, enable FROM system_announcement WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE system_announcement SET message = #{message}, severity = #{severity}, enable = #{enable} WHERE id = 1
mapper.sql: FROM status_management_event_history h INNER JOIN status_management_event e ON e.id = h.event_id INNER JOIN status_management_category c ON c.id = e.id_category

where.if: AND ( h.notes LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR CONCAT('E-', YEAR(COALESCE(h.opened_date, e.updated_date)), '-', LPAD(e.id, 3, '0')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.id AS event_id, CONCAT('E-', YEAR(e.updated_date), '-', LPAD(e.id, 3, '0')) AS event_number, e.id_category AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, e.status, e.status_number, e.notes AS description, e.admin_notes, e.updated_by, 'closed' AS action_type, DATE_FORMAT(e.updated_date, '%b %e, %Y %l:%i %p') AS date_formatted, e.updated_date AS event_created_date, e.updated_date AS event_updated_date, e.updated_date AS event_closed_date, NULL AS duration_minutes, '-' AS duration_formatted, e.updated_date AS history_created_date FROM status_management_event e INNER JOIN status_management_category c ON c.id = e.id_category WHERE e.id = #{eventId} -- AND e.closed = 1 ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1
